threshold: Frozen calibration threshold; no evaluation retuning or below-threshold fallback
quota: At most share_percent times total daily slots; draw only from capacity remaining after mandatory pins
baseline_remainder: Existing baseline ordering, no additional IF reranking
mandatory: Preserve frozen baseline-selected cao_nhat and nontransaction work still pending; extra pending hard work precedes discovery
candidate: Evaluation-only IF score >= frozen threshold; transaction and document have never appeared in admitted baseline scope before the daily cutoff
document_key: company plus invoice_id, else journal_document_id, else transaction_id
case_unit: One IF lead transaction per document; highest available IF score; one review per document per study arm
dedup: Exclude admitted baseline transaction/context/evidence members and invoice source scopes cumulatively; stop pending IF lead when baseline absorbs its document
subsequent_baseline: Do not auto-complete later baseline work after an IF review; record additional review effort and overlap
causality: All eligibility and ordering use observations strictly before next Vietnam midnight; future baseline admission annotated only after selection
outcomes: No independent outcomes or measured minutes inferred; pending human review
